title: Chapter 1335
text:
The two of them talked for a while and reached a consensus. Han Xiao left a Throne and a Lord's Avatar in Destiny's Child's laboratory. He interacted with Destiny's Child for a while before leaving the room. He turned around to visit and comfort the many revivors who were living in seclusion in the Holy Covenant. The two sides had a meeting.

The current president of the Beyond Grade A Association pointed out in the meeting that the Holy Covenant organization had to pay attention to the spiritual civilization of the revivors, help the revivors to keep up with the pace of the times, implement the basic principles of people-oriented, and implement the 'two ones' requirement, which was to 'ensure the treatment of every revivor and not lose their vigilance'. He eagerly hoped that Oathkeeper would be a good role model.

The leader of the Holy Covenant organization, Oathkeeper, highly praised the current results of the association and emphasized that the two sides had always been in a positive relationship, contributing to the Beyond Grade As together. He hoped that the association would continue to focus on the common cause and cooperate with the Holy Covenant's strategic assistance.

Many revivors expressed their admiration for Black Star's contributions to the Beyond Grade A cause and unanimously welcomed Black Star to come again to provide guidance and spur the Holy Covenant organization.

No matter what, the two sides had a full exchange of opinions. After the daily exchanges, Han Xiao left the Holy Covenant base and teleported back to the Black Star Palace a few Star Fields away.

Returning to his office, Han Xiao rubbed his chin. Without any delay, he contacted the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations and sent the information he had obtained from Destiny's Child through the encrypted channel.

Not long after, his communicator rang. He received a remote conversation invitation.

Han Xiao turned on the remote projection and arrived at the joint office of the three Universal Civilizations' leaders. He immediately saw the three of them with gloomy expressions.

"Black Star, where did you get this information? Is it true? You have to be responsible for spouting nonsense! "

As soon as they met, Marbruce asked a series of questions. His tone was extremely serious as if he was questioning him.

According to the information provided by Han Xiao, the World Tree Civilization had already noticed the traces of the outsiders and was thinking of ways to track them. This was a huge matter that affected the overall strategy, so they could not be careless.

This intelligence did not contain any evidence, and it looked like an irresponsible guess. Furthermore, even they only dared to carefully explore the uninhabited areas and had no clue about the World Tree Civilization's movements. Then, where did Han Xiao's intelligence come from? The three of them couldn't help but doubt the authenticity of this statement.

"I have a special intelligence channel. This is a special Primal Esper Ability Entity called Destiny's Child. It has extraordinary abilities at the Information Form level …" Han Xiao explained Destiny's Child's abilities.

"Child of Destiny?"

The three of them looked at each other. Their small eyes were filled with doubt.

This Primal Esper Ability Entity did not exist in the known Super High Risk Esper Ability Tables, nor was it recorded in the confidential database of the three Universal Civilizations. This was the first time the three of them had heard of this Primal Esper Ability Entity.

"So you guys really don't know?" Han Xiao was helpless.

He had once inquired about Destiny's Child's information, but there was no record of it in the dynasty's database. He had thought that the relevant information might be stored in the confidential database. It seemed like the three Universal Civilizations did not know about the existence of Destiny's Child either. However, the Information Form ability was indeed good at hiding its existence.

"Is Destiny's Child currently in your hands? Is it reliable? "Louis asked.

"It is indeed in my hands, and there's no problem with the intelligence."

Han Xiao nodded and hid the existence of the Holy Covenant.

Hearing this, the Ethereal Pope said with a deep voice, "There's no proof. We have to check before we can confirm its authenticity. Furthermore, such an intelligence channel should be controlled by us."

Han Xiao shook his head and said with a heavier tone.

"At this point, you guys still have doubts about me? Who provided the confidential information about the World Tree? It was me, right? I showed my sincerity, but what did you guys do? In order to confirm if my information was true, you guys went to explore the World Tree Civilization through the wormhole, which eventually led to your exposure … Of course, from your standpoint, this is understandable. I understand you guys, but it's also a fact that you were detected by the enemy. No matter how correct your motives are, you can't change the bad outcome … It's because I knew that you guys might mess up, so I didn't tell you about the existence of the World Tree in the past. "

The three of them froze.

Marbruce coughed and took the initiative to explain.

"It's not that we doubt you, but we can't casually believe information with questionable authenticity. If we don't confirm it beforehand, it will be too late when the problem occurs …"

"This isn't the first time you guys have said this, but what happened in the end? You guys are still acting according to the confidential information I provided. The so-called confirmation is just unnecessary in my opinion, and it will only increase the risk of exposure. "

The three of them opened their mouths, not knowing what to say.

Louis said, "Black Star, don't be agitated. We've always been cautious and haven't met any life forms of the World Tree Civilization. With just the perception of a Primal Esper Ability Form, I don't think we can be 100% sure that the other party has already detected our existence …"

"You still want to be 100% sure?" Han Xiao's eyes widened. "Then, why don't we just show up and ask the World Tree Civilization? That way, it'll definitely be 100% sure."

Louis's lips twitched, and he stopped talking.

Marbruce said helplessly, "But the information …"

Han Xiao interrupted Marbruce and said, "I know you guys are worried.

I don't expect you guys to trust me completely, but you guys stole the information on the network, so you should have confirmed the World Tree's attitude toward the outside world. Since everyone is prey, then we're already on the same side. Do you still need to worry about me having any bad intentions and specially guard against me?

The threat is imminent, and now is not the time for internal suspicion. Be it me or you guys, we have to believe that what we're doing is for the same goal. We won't deliberately cause trouble. If I hadn't confirmed the authenticity of this information, would I have said it? If this information channel is exposed because you guys insist on checking, what should we do? "

The three of them frowned.

That was right. They were all comrades now, so they should trust each other.

However, could it be that Black Star deliberately did not want them to confirm it to hide the fishy nature of this information … They could not help but think in this direction. Their identities determined that they had to consider all kinds of situations.

Seeing their reactions, Han Xiao knew what they were thinking and shook his head in disappointment.

"At the end of the day, countless years of peace have made you guys arrogant, thinking that you can deal with any situation … Maybe my information gave you guys too much of an illusion, making you guys feel that you have the advantage and can control the situation … You're completely wrong! I hope you guys can recognize reality. The World Tree is stronger than all of you combined. As long as it finds us and starts a war, the situation will instantly go out of control. We'll be destroyed at any time and become the next Karma Republic! "

"… Then what do you suggest?" Marbruce asked.

"I'll be direct. I won't hand over this information channel to you guys. Even if you don't believe me now, you should consider how to deal with this situation. The World Tree Civilization has advanced unknown detection methods and has discovered traces of outsiders. They have entered a state of alert, but they have not succeeded in tracking them … Therefore, I suggest that we stop the regular exploration and reduce the chances of further contact. We should temporarily wait and give more time for the secondary dimension expedition team to find the World Tree's main body. "

"But if we don't explore, how are we going to get the information?"

"With all due respect, most of the information you guys have obtained so far is meaningless. Since there are no results, you might as well stop and use Destiny's Child's channel."

"What you mean is that we don't have to do anything and just have to listen to you obediently. We'll believe whatever you say … Do you think that's possible?"

The Ethereal Pope at the side spoke with a dissatisfied tone. He paused for a moment before adding,

"Either hand over Destiny's Child to us, or let us send researchers to study it together to prove that the information is reliable."

Han Xiao laughed.

"Are you forcing me now? Yes, I can make concessions for the sake of righteousness. Let's study Destiny's Child together and dispel your suspicions. As long as we don't do that, it will seem like it's my fault. Because I have the channel, I have to make concessions. If I don't let you guys have a share, you won't accept my opinion. "

"You're mistaken. We …" Marbruce felt that the atmosphere was a little off and wanted to explain.

Han Xiao interrupted him, and his smile slowly turned cold.

"You three dogsh * t things, I've tolerated you guys for a long time! You guys don't seem to have figured out who needs who. Do you really think I have no choice? I'm willing to protect the galactic society, which is why I'm cold. However, the universe is so big. Is this the only place you guys can stay? If you piss me off, I'll just leave with the Beyond Grade A Association and the organizations under me. Whether it's to the unexplored universe or the secondary dimensions, I'll leave you guys to deal with the World Tree Civilization alone. Do you want to try? "

The three of them were shocked.

They had almost forgotten that the Beyond Grade A Association had a way out. With their abilities, even if they escaped to the unexplored universe, they would be able to live very well. To the three Universal Civilizations, this was definitely the worst outcome.

As long as the Beyond Grade As made up their minds, they could completely abandon the galactic society that they had lived in for a long time. To be honest, even if all the living beings here died, it would not have anything to do with most of the Beyond Grade As. There was no reason for them to stay and fight.

If news of the World Tree spread, there would definitely be people who would choose to escape. If even Black Star, who had mastered the Sanctum Revival, was not willing to stay, one could imagine the choices of the other Beyond Grade As.

With such influence, Black Star was not a partner with no way out but an equal with the bargaining power. He was a force that they had to fight for.

Marbruce could not sit still anymore and hurriedly said, "Don't be angry. That's not what we meant."

"Black Star … Your Excellency, we're just stating the facts. We don't have any thoughts of benefits." Louis also hurriedly comforted him.

"… It was my bad choice of words that caused a misunderstanding. Please don't take it to heart."

The Ethereal Pope had no choice but to lower his head, feeling depressed.

Even after being scolded, we still have to take the initiative to apologize. As the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations, when have we ever been so humble?

Seeing this, Han Xiao put away his anger and regained his expressionless face. He slowly said,

"I'll continue to share the information. Whether you believe me or not is your business. I can't be bothered. Also, I'll be making a trip to the World Tree Civilization's territory in a while to increase the surveillance of Destiny's Child. Remember to prepare the World Tree channel or the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device … If we don't even have this bit of trust, I don't think there's a need for us to cooperate. "

"Alright, we'll take care of it."

Marbruce answered before the other two. Now was not the time to continue bargaining.

Han Xiao nodded and suddenly said, "There's another thing.

Hurry up and fulfill your promise and admit the independence of the association. Don't think about delaying it again and again. Don't think that you can shirk it off just because the war breaks out. It's still the same. At most, I'll just leave. "

With that, the communication ended, and the remote projection disappeared.

Only the three of them were left in the room. They looked at each other with complicated expressions.

"I didn't expect to be scolded by him in front of everyone. Did we force him too much?" Louis smiled bitterly.

"Don't underestimate him. How can a formidable person like Black Star lose his composure so easily? He's just using this as an excuse to make a fuss." The Ethereal Pope shook his head, paused, and said helplessly, "But he did hit the nail on the head."

"Black Star is really …" Marbruce hesitated for a moment before sighing. "He's fully fledged."

…

On the other side, Han Xiao turned around and returned to his office.

He snorted and threw the communicator aside.

"These three b * stards have dog faces. If I don't give them two slaps, they won't know who's the daddy now."
